about: P30A T4 pre-baked panoramas for settings the arcade library (src/play/arcade/look/env-catalog.json) has no tag for. Vocabulary written by hand from the general list and the gaps in evals/play/p30/dev.json and the play corpora; `horizon` is filled by scripts/cloud/bake-panoramas.mjs once public/play/env/<id>.webp exists. An entry without `horizon` is not baked yet and is never picked.
